item.title: Otaku Vampire's Love Bite Gets a TV Anime: VIZ Reveals First Teaser
item.description: VIZ announced a television adaptation of Julietta Suzuki's Otaku Vampire's Love Bite on November 3, 2026, with teaser visuals but no premiere date.

item.title: Shiba Inu Rooms TV Anime Announced for Summer 2027 With First Cast
item.description: The supernatural comedy Shiba Inu Rooms is getting a TV anime in summer 2027, with a teaser and initial cast and staff announced.

item.title: The Remarried Empress Volume 11 Has an Official English Print Edition
item.description: Ize Press lists The Remarried Empress Vol. 11 for October 20, 2026 in the US, with the original story and adaptation team credited.
